description:
Consider a process for purchasing items from an online shop.
The user starts an order by logging in to their account.
Then, the user simultaneously selects the items to purchase and sets a payment method.
Afterward, the user either pays or completes an installment agreement.
After selecting the items, the user chooses between multiple options for a free reward.
Since the reward value depends on the purchase value, this step is done after selecting the items, but it is independent of the payment activities.
Finally, the items are delivered.
The user has the right to return items for exchange.
Every time items are returned, a new delivery is made.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/online-shop">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_OnlineShopPurchase" name="Purchase items from an online shop" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Order" name="Order started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Login</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Login" name="Log in to account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Login</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Login_ParallelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Select items and set payment method">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Login_ParallelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_SelectItems</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_SetPayment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectItems" name="Select items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_SelectItems</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectItems_ChooseReward</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseReward" name="Choose a free reward">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectItems_ChooseReward</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reward_ParallelJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetPaymentMethod" name="Set payment method">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_SetPayment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SetPayment_PaymentChoice</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentChoice" name="Choose payment option">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SetPayment_PaymentChoice</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Choice_Pay</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Choice_Installment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Pay" name="Pay">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Choice_Pay</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Pay_PaymentMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InstallmentAgreement" name="Complete installment agreement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Choice_Installment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Installment_PaymentMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentMerge" name="Payment option completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Pay_PaymentMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Installment_PaymentMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaymentMerge_ParallelJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Reward and payment activities complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Reward_ParallelJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PaymentMerge_ParallelJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ParallelJoin_Deliver</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverItems" name="Deliver items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ParallelJoin_Deliver</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Return_Deliver</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Deliver_ReturnChoice</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReturnChoice" name="Return items for exchange?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Deliver_ReturnChoice</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnChoice_Return</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnChoice_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReturnItems" name="Return items for exchange">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnChoice_Return</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Return_Deliver</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderComplete" name="Order complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnChoice_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Login" sourceRef="StartEvent_Order" targetRef="Task_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Login_ParallelSplit" sourceRef="Task_Login" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_SelectItems" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_SelectItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_SetPayment" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_SetPaymentMethod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectItems_ChooseReward" sourceRef="Task_SelectItems" targetRef="Task_ChooseReward"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reward_ParallelJoin" sourceRef="Task_ChooseReward" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SetPayment_PaymentChoice" sourceRef="Task_SetPaymentMethod" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Choice_Pay" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentChoice" targetRef="Task_Pay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Choice_Installment" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentChoice" targetRef="Task_InstallmentAgreement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Pay_PaymentMerge" sourceRef="Task_Pay" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Installment_PaymentMerge" sourceRef="Task_InstallmentAgreement" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentMerge_ParallelJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelJoin_Deliver" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_DeliverItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deliver_ReturnChoice" sourceRef="Task_DeliverItems" targetRef="Gateway_ReturnChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnChoice_Return" name="Return for exchange" sourceRef="Gateway_ReturnChoice" targetRef="Task_ReturnItems">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">returnForExchange</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnChoice_End" name="No return" sourceRef="Gateway_ReturnChoice" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_Deliver" sourceRef="Task_ReturnItems" targetRef="Task_DeliverItems"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
